requirement: At least two independent public data sources
required_evidence: dataset citations and immutable release identifiers

requirement: Evaluated scan is not used to build its target map
Target map and evaluated scan have independent source acquisition
Time synchronization and extrinsics are auditable
Each dataset has at least 50 corridor or weak-geometry snapshots and 50 geometry-rich snapshots
Scene labels are frozen before registration error is viewed
Open3D and PCL share identical inputs
Frozen Open3D and PCL parameters are retained
Reference trajectory, map, and interpolation uncertainty are recorded
Primary effect exceeds synthetic and real-reference uncertainty budgets
Continuous errors are primary; an arbitrary success threshold is not the sole result
Common-association metrics use the frozen offline definition
Scene intervals cannot be reselected after results are inspected
